Package index

Testing

Functions for testing one network statistic against random networks, networks with the same degrees, or permutations of the network:

test_random() test_configuration() test_permutation() tidy(<network_test>) summary(<network_test>) glance(<network_test>)
Tests of network measures

Specifying

Functions for reading one formula for an MRQAP or an ERGM, for listing the terms that suit a network, the terms of an MRQAP formula and what each measures, and the coefficients of a model:

specify_ergm() summary(<ergm_formula>) tidy(<ergm_formula>)
Specify an ERGM from a formula written for any model
specify_mrqap() summary(<mrqap_formula>) tidy(<mrqap_formula>)
Specify an MRQAP from a formula written for any model
specify_saom() summary(<saom_formula>)
Specify a SAOM from a formula written for any model
formula(<specify_terms>) summary(<specify_terms>) tidy(<specify_terms>)
The terms that suit a network
terms_mrqap
Terms of an MRQAP formula
declare_coefs() coef(<infernetMrqapCoefs>) coef(<infernetMrqapFit>)
Declare the coefficients of a model
declare_coefs(<ergm_formula>) declare_coefs(<ergm>) coef(<infernetErgmCoefs>) simulate(<infernetErgmCoefs>)
Declare the coefficients of an ERGM

Estimating

Functions for regressing a network on nodal and dyadic covariates by multiple regression quadratic assignment procedure (MRQAP), with random or fixed effects, missing data, panels, and cognitive social structures, the controls of a model, and the tidy results of other network models:

print(<infernetMrqapFit>) estimate_mrqap() tidy(<infernetMrqapFit>) summary(<infernetMrqapFit>) glance(<infernetMrqapFit>)
Regression for network data
set_control_computation() control_computation() c(<mrqap_control>)
Computation controls for the session or for one call
control_mrqap()
Controls for an MRQAP
tidy(<netlm>) tidy(<netlogit>) glance(<netlm>) glance(<netlogit>) tidy(<ergm>) glance(<ergm>) tidy(<sienaFit>) glance(<sienaFit>)
Tidying the results of other network models

Evaluating

Functions for diagnosing issues with a fitted model and its residuals, for testing its fit against its simulations, for testing its coefficients, and for comparing models by their likelihood:

diagnose_confusion() tidy(<infernetConfusion>) glance(<infernetConfusion>)
Diagnosing how well a model classifies ties
diagnose_outliers()
Finding the outliers of a fitted model
fitted(<infernetMrqapFit>) residuals(<infernetMrqapFit>)
The fitted values and residuals of a network regression
diagnose_changepoints() diagnose_onset()
Diagnosing a model of a sequence over time
test_gof() test_distributions()
Tests of model fit
test_parameter() anova(<infernetMrqapFit>) test_time()
Tests of a model's coefficients
nobs(<infernetMrqapFit>) logLik(<infernetMrqapFit>) deviance(<infernetMrqapFit>)
Comparing network regressions by their likelihood

Interpreting

Functions for predicting from a model and reading its terms, for simulating networks from a model, for simulating many diffusions on a network, and for sweeping a diffusion or an opinion dynamic over its settings:

predict(<infernetMrqapFit>) predict(<netlm>) predict(<netlogit>) formula(<infernetMrqapFit>) terms(<infernetMrqapFit>)
Predicting from a network regression, and its terms
declare_coefs(<ergm_formula>) declare_coefs(<ergm>) coef(<infernetErgmCoefs>) simulate(<infernetErgmCoefs>)
Declare the coefficients of an ERGM
simulate(<infernetMrqapFit>) simulate(<infernetMrqapCoefs>) simulate(<mrqap_formula>)
Simulate networks from an MRQAP
play_diffusions() summary(<diffs_model>) `[`(<diffs_model>)
Simulating many diffusions
sweep_diffusion() sweep_opinion() summary(<diffusionSweep>) summary(<opinionSweep>)
Sweeping a diffusion or an opinion dynamic over its settings
